sloka: निशि भान्त्यचलेन्द्रस्य हुताशनशिखा इव ।ओषध्य: स्वप्रभालक्ष्या भ्राजमाना: सहस्रश: ॥ २.९४.२१॥
transliteration: niśi bhāntyacalendrasya hutāśanaśikhā iva ।oṣadhya: svaprabhālakṣyā bhrājamānā: sahasraśa: ॥ 2.94.21॥

translations.english: Herbs in thousands on this king of the hills shine in the night with the splendour of their own lustre, like flames of fire.
